-- Check event-driven calculation: % of transactions with corpeventprx per trader
WITH event_stats AS (
    SELECT trdref, 
           COUNT(*) as total_txns,
           COUNT(corpeventprx) as event_txns
    FROM transactionrecord t
    LEFT JOIN sentimentandfundamentals sf ON t.transreg = sf.transref
    GROUP BY trdref
)
SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(total_txns AS numeric) > 0 THEN CAST(event_txns AS numeric) / total_txns ELSE 0 END as event_pct, *
FROM event_stats
WHERE total_txns > 0
ORDER BY event_pct DESC
LIMIT 10;

-- Step 1: Identify Event-Driven traders (>30% corpeventprx non-null)
WITH event_stats AS (
    SELECT trdref, 
           COUNT(*) as total_txns,
           COUNT(corpeventprx) as event_txns
    FROM transactionrecord t
    LEFT JOIN sentimentandfundamentals sf ON t.transreg = sf.transref
    GROUP BY trdref
),
event_driven_traders AS (
    SELECT trdref
    FROM event_stats
    WHERE CAST(event_txns * 1.0 / total_txns > 0.30
),
-- Step 2: Add risk level check for Aggressive
aggressive_speculators AS (
    SELECT e.trdref
    FROM event_driven_traders e
    JOIN trader t ON e.trdref = t.tradereg
    WHERE t.trading_performance::json->'risklevel'->>'risklevel' = 'Aggressive'
),
-- Step 3: Add SDF > 1.0 check
volatile_speculators AS (
    SELECT a.trdref
    FROM aggressive_speculators a
    JOIN sentimentandfundamentals sf ON a.trdref = t.traderef
    JOIN sentimentandfundamentals sf ON t.traderef = sf.trdref2
    WHERE ABS(sf.newsscore - sf.socscore) > 1.0
)
SELECT * FROM volatile_speculators;
